title: Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract Provisions: Activation and the Aggregate Limit of Liability
content:
**Provision.** A plan is activated when the selling dealer remits it; the aggregate limit established is the vehicle purchase price, on the basis of the vehicle purchase price on the bill of sale, but never more than the maximum aggregate limit set for the plan.

## Activation

A Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract plan is sold first and stands as pending activation until the selling Kestrel dealer remits it. On the dealer's remittance the plan's coverage is registered and the plan becomes active. Activation is a system event on remittance; the holder does not perform it.

## The aggregate limit of liability

On activation the plan's aggregate limit of liability is established and booked as of the activation date. The amount established is:

- the vehicle purchase price shown on the bill of sale,
- but never more than the maximum aggregate limit set for the plan held, which differs from Kestrel Care Powertrain through Kestrel Care Platinum Elite.

The limit established is therefore the lower of the vehicle purchase price on the bill of sale and the plan's maximum aggregate limit. Afterwards the remaining limit is reduced by each claim paid and restored by a claim payment reversal.

| Vehicle purchase price on the bill of sale, compared with the plan's maximum | Limit established |
|---|---|
| Below the maximum | The purchase price |
| Equal to the maximum | The maximum, which is the same figure |
| Above the maximum | The maximum |

### Worked figures (hypothetical plan maximum of 20000.00)

| Hypothetical purchase price | Limit established |
|---|---|
| 17250.00 | 17250.00 — the price is below the maximum |
| 20000.00 | 20000.00 — price and maximum coincide |
| 26500.00 | 20000.00 — the maximum applies |

The 20000.00 maximum above is an illustration only; each plan's own maximum is the figure set for that plan.
